posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
And now that I've actually listened to it:

I would totally listen to a "Heartbreaker and Equity Kill the Sentinels Universe" episode, FYI. Like it would honestly be rather fascinatingly interesting. Stop looking at me like that.

I love that Sentinels of the Ninth is a thing that actually happened in actual comics canon just because of the quantity of super serious characters talked into it and how goofy some of the cards are.

Full disclosure (explanation?): I was actually the other person that SpectralTime talked to regards the Fanatic thing over Reddit. He actually suggested that I send in the letter, but I basically said that I felt more disappointed than actually critical, so I didn't feel like it was a thing I wanted to do. And his letter went in a somewhat different direction anyway that was probably more interesting than what I would have had to say.

You think I'd be going against the spirit of the whole Cosmic Contest... er... contest if I made a thread about it? Like I know we're all supposed to individually guess rather than crowdsource, but an actual endorsement of "who would beat up who in a fight" thinking seems like too juicy a discussion topic to pass up.

posts.name: RySmith6
posts.cooked:
mwc146:

Neither of them seemed too interested in actually fighting

This is the biggest question to me. Some characters are… less than motivated to fight, unless specifically threatened or encouraged to do so. Frankly, I'm not sure Zhu Long would make it out of the first round, as they're generally not the one to go all in and fight for the sake of it.

I'm hoping they'll take some questions about specific rules, because otherwise "winning" in each round could look very different.

specifically, can we assume:

A) Each character has sufficent motivation to fight and be declared the victor in each match.

A-1)Characters have no reason to collude to "throw" matches in order to set up specific advantages for allies.

B) This is a no-kill tourney(no extra advantage for Haka, etc.).

B-1) Knock-outs and Tap-outs are the only real cause for elimination

C) Characters are limited by some arbitrary contraints placed upon them by Jansa.

C-1)Characters with underlings(Chairman, Kaargra) are limited to fighting alone.

C-2)Characters are constrained to some spatial boundaries

C-3)Characters must fight with whatever they had on hand when summoned, or what Jansa decides is worth bringing along to accurately evaluate their abilities.

 

Sure, a no-rules scenario sounds good, but that essentially means the fights are pointless, as "story reasons" can dictate the outcome of any given match. Now if they're asking us to predict the actual story outcome of the Cosmic Contest event, that's a slightly different matter…
